name: Volatile
description: Taking at least 1❤️ damage at once lights your fuse for 2 seconds, ending in a fiery explosion which ignites and deals [effect:dmg][dark-gray]1.5-6❤️ damage[/dark-gray][/effect] to enemies within 5 blocks.

effects.explanation:
Level I: 1.5❤️ damage
Level II: 3❤️ damage
Level III: 4.5❤️ damage
Level IV: 6❤️ damage
